CRPC.description: Creep Coefficient for Construction Stage (CRPC). Keyed by element (entity) id; ITEMS holds one entry per load group, each carrying a creep coefficient applied for that group.

ITEMS.description: Array of creep-coefficient entries for this element. Each entry pairs a load group with its creep coefficient.

ID.description: Serial number of the entry within the element. Optional; when omitted or 0 the group name determines the target entry.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of an existing load group. Must match a defined load group name; an empty string means no group (group key 0). A non-empty name that does not exist is rejected.

CREEP.description: Creep coefficient value applied for this load group.
